# Third-party schemas

`erc7730-v2.schema.json` is the ERC-7730 v2 descriptor schema, copied unchanged from
<https://eips.ethereum.org/assets/eip-7730/erc7730-v2.schema.json>. ERC-7730 is a draft and is
released under CC0. The test suite validates exported descriptors against this copy, so a change
upstream will not silently change what the tests prove. Update the copy deliberately.
